title: Add a projector for built-in gate presets
description:
Built-in gate presets are defined in Rust and can change without a maintained documentation surface. Add a deterministic projection that distinguishes shipped presets from project-local registries.

Source: `crates/jit/src/gate_presets/builtin.rs:1-6,43-117,313-372`; `crates/jit/src/gate_presets/manager.rs:27-44,111-137`; `crates/jit/src/commands/invariant.rs:1-23`; `crates/jit/src/commands/reference.rs:1-19`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A deterministic discoverable projection renders every built-in preset with gate keys, stages, modes, descriptions, and relevant checker metadata.
- [hard] REQ-02: The rendered surface distinguishes shipped presets from project-local/custom configuration.
- [hard] REQ-03: Freshness coverage fails when a built-in preset or gate definition changes without regeneration.
